instruction: The method name `to_url` on `BaseConverter` (src/werkzeug/routing/converters.py) reads as if it builds a whole URL, but it only encodes one value. Rename `BaseConverter.to_url` to `encode_value`. The rename must cover the base class, every subclass that overrides it, and every place that calls or refers to it, including tests. Leave comments, docstrings and other documentation text unchanged. Behavior must not change: the project must still work and its tests must pass.

--- a/src/werkzeug/routing/converters.py
+++ b/src/werkzeug/routing/converters.py
@@ -40,7 +40,7 @@ class BaseConverter:
     def to_python(self, value: str) -> t.Any:
         return value
 
-    def to_url(self, value: t.Any) -> str:
+    def encode_value(self, value: t.Any) -> str:
         # safe = https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#url-path-segment-string
         return quote(str(value), safe="!$&'()*+,/:;=@")
 
@@ -101,7 +101,7 @@ class AnyConverter(BaseConverter):
         self.items = set(items)
         self.regex = f"(?:{'|'.join([re.escape(x) for x in items])})"
 
-    def to_url(self, value: t.Any) -> str:
+    def encode_value(self, value: t.Any) -> str:
         if value in self.items:
             return str(value)
 
@@ -159,7 +159,7 @@ class NumberConverter(BaseConverter):
             raise ValidationError()
         return value_num
 
-    def to_url(self, value: t.Any) -> str:
+    def encode_value(self, value: t.Any) -> str:
         value_str = str(self.num_convert(value))
         if self.fixed_digits:
             value_str = value_str.zfill(self.fixed_digits)
@@ -229,7 +229,7 @@ class FloatConverter(NumberConverter):
     ) -> None:
         super().__init__(map, min=min, max=max, signed=signed)  # type: ignore
 
-    def to_url(self, value: t.Any) -> str:
+    def encode_value(self, value: t.Any) -> str:
         # f format ensures no scientific notation, but forces trailing zeroes
         return f"{self.num_convert(value):f}".rstrip("0")
 
@@ -252,7 +252,7 @@ class UUIDConverter(BaseConverter):
     def to_python(self, value: str) -> uuid.UUID:
         return uuid.UUID(value)
 
-    def to_url(self, value: uuid.UUID) -> str:
+    def encode_value(self, value: uuid.UUID) -> str:
         return str(value)
